ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_regret_delta_regret_exp_weighted_mean_relu
ir.intuition: Maintain the pairwise regret difference with exponential decay link and ReLU non-negativity, aggregating by weighted mean for vectorized compatibility.
ir.pseudocode:
scaled = clamp(alpha * delta_regret, 0, 10)
decay_link = exp(-scaled)
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss_per_pair = weight * relu(1 - decay_link * margin)
loss = sum(loss_per_pair) / sum(weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scaled = ops.clamp(ops.mul(alpha, delta_regret), 0.0, 10.0)
    decay_link = ops.exp(ops.neg(scaled))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    inner = ops.sub(1.0, ops.mul(decay_link, margin))
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(weight, ops.relu(inner))
    total_weight = weight.sum().clamp(min=eps)
    loss = loss_per_pair.sum() / total_weight
    return loss
